title: What Is Chemistry? Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
Why does ice float in water? Why does a cut apple turn brown? Where does salt go when it vanishes in water? Three small kitchen puzzles, one science behind all of them. This animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 1, Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry) builds the ground floor every beginner needs before anything else.

You will see what chemistry is (the study of matter, anything that has mass and takes up space), watch particles move in a solid, a liquid and a gas, and zoom from a drop of water down to molecules, atoms and the protons, neutrons and electrons inside. On the molecule bench, electrons move in to build O2, H2O and CO2 bond by bond, showing the difference between an element and a compound. Then we learn to read any formula (symbols, small numbers, big numbers and brackets), compare a physical change (ice melting) with a chemical change (iron rusting), map the three chapters ahead and the five branches of chemistry, and count the 24 atoms in one molecule of glucose, C6H12O6. Then the exam trap (2H is not H2), an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 1 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students.
